# Renewal on runs and the relational reading of living

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Renewal and consumption are classes of runs; under a correspondence discipline a common condition gives connection, and significance passes along co-participation.

`becoming-renewal-reading` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07

Editable record: [becoming-renewal-reading.json](becoming-renewal-reading.json) · [Register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

Documentary review UTC: `2026-10-13T09:54:07+00:00`. Run the registry checker for source drift; this page is not a fresh proof receipt.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Every run of every process, read through observables of conditions, is one relational unfolding to which the renewing/consuming classification applies. A natural-number observable that never rises from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps; depletion, recurrent renewal under a natural rank and unrenewed drawdown are its cases. The class belongs to the run: in one process from one configuration, with the focal formation active at every step, one run renews and another consumes. Reading living formation events relationally and relating events whose formations participate in a common condition, a condition in which every living formation participates makes the whole connected, so living significance is exactly a seed with relational and standpoint neutrality; disjoint conditions can leave it unconnected. A consumer and the formation it consumes participate in the drawn condition, so under relational neutrality a standpoint valuing the consumer's activity holds significant every living event of the formation it consumes; the transmission runs along co-participation and does not use consumption itself.

Canonical source: [Renewal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Renewal.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Levels of conditions, activity, dependence (with its level) and drawing are observables of configurations; dependence and drawing do not vary with the configuration.
- `living` is the whole-run relational reading (active and not consuming) and `related` is participation in a common condition; both are disclosed reading choices, not proved correspondences.
- The connection result needs a condition in which every living formation participates, and depends on a correspondence discipline for what counts as a condition and as participation; the transmission result needs N_rel, whose normative standing this result does not prove.

Formations and conditions are analytic roles in one unfolding, not independent entities or owners of value. Connection depends on what counts as a condition and as participation: adding a condition everyone depends on at level 0 connects everything for free, while a too coarse common condition empties living (independent review Q4, Q10); a discipline excluding idle conditions is stated in condition-correspondence-discipline, which does not exclude a renewed condition every formation depends on at a positive level, used once by one living event, and does not resolve Q10. The reading is relative to a run. The correspondence of observables to an actual history, whether a common condition (such as the biosphere or climate) is in fact participated in by every living formation, and whether the relational reading is the right reading of 生生 are application or philosophical duties.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). This record binds Bridge to the new frozen receipt while other proofs retain their original receipts; adapters are not independent results.

Proves none of S0, N, A, C, L or J and binds no position rejecting them. The unification of bounds is organizational, not new mathematics; ContinuationRenewal's well-founded form is not derived from the principle. The relational reading and the common-participation relation are disclosed reading choices; whether they are the right reading of 生生, and the empirical correspondence of common conditions, lie outside this result. The correspondence discipline for conditions is stated for the stepwise reading only (condition-correspondence-discipline); the reading is relative to a run and includes no component of further generation. A formation's class (RenewingIn, ConsumingIn) depends on identity across steps, while a condition's class does not (identity-across-steps).

- Disjoint conditions: two formations are living and neither consumes, yet the whole is unconnected (Separate.not_connected); connection is a fact of the unfolding and can fail. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)
- The renewable model has no feedback: the loss in the run beyond renewal persists only because drawing keeps exceeding renewal; irreversible loss needs the feedback of the RelationalRenewal law family. [Renewal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Renewal.lean)
- Dependence is static and the reading is whole-run rather than stepwise; both are inherited from existing modules. This result holds at that scope; becoming-dependence-dynamics and becoming-stepwise-reading relax both (integration note §6). [BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md)
- Independent review: the philosophical warrant for the relational reading is not established; “consumption is itself a formed relation” is withdrawn in favour of co-participation, and “connection is given by the unfolding” becomes “given by a common condition under a correspondence discipline”.
